- Price graphs directly in the app.
- Integrated Cold Wallet, all you need is a spare phone.
- Transaction batching. Save space on the blockchain and pay lower fees!
- Full control of your private keys. They never leave your device.
- Full SegWit support including generating and sending to Bech32 addresses.
- Hierarchical Deterministic (using BIP 32, 39, 44, 49, 84).
- Receive address validation. Use the COINiD Vault to validate generated addresses.
- Smart fee estimation. Never overpay fees.
- Biometric authentication on supported phones.
